origin.says: Simplified from 滬: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 扈 (retinue) as the sound, cut down to 户 (door): a river, now the short name of Shanghai.

沁.def: to soak, to seep in, to percolate

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 心 (heart) as the sound: water seeping in.

沁.name: percolate

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 冘 (an old character) as the sound: what comes from the heart, sincerity.
礻 (altar, spirit) for the meaning plus 巳 (sixth branch) as the sound: offerings to the spirits, to sacrifice, worship.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 𠂔 (an old sound part) for the sound: elder sister.
厶 (an old form of 以) as the sound plus 矢 (arrow), which may also hint at the sound. An old sentence-final particle marking something done, like an arrow already shot.
圭 (jade tablet) as the sound plus 卜 (divination crack) for the meaning: a divination figure, one of the trigrams or hexagrams. 圭 looks like two 土 (earth) but first drew ritual axes.

坷.def: uneven, bumpy; a clod of earth; a lump of soil

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 可 (can) as the sound: a lump of earth, so bumpy, uneven ground.

坷.name: clod

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 丕 (great) as the sound: unfired clay, an earthen blank before baking; then any unfinished piece.
土 (earth) plus 申 (extend; a cyclic sign): the earth, the female principle opposite 乾 (heaven). Sources differ on which part gives the sound.

拎.def: to lift, to haul, to take

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 令 (command) as the sound: to carry something hanging from the hand.

拎.name: dangle carry

拂.def: to shake off, to brush away; dust

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 弗 (not) as the sound: to brush away with the hand.

拂.name: brush off

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 母 (mother) as the sound and perhaps meaning: the 'mother' finger, the thumb.

拗.def: to pull, to drag; perverse, obstinate; bent, warped

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 幼 (young) as the sound: to bend or twist by hand, hence warped and stubborn.

拗.name: stubborn bend

origin.says: 艹 (grass, plant) for the meaning plus 末 (tip) as the sound: the jasmine plant, a name taken over from a foreign word.
艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 可 (can) as the sound. First small, thorny plants, then something petty and harsh: severe, exacting.
艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 夗 (curled up) as the sound: an enclosed park with plants and animals.

苞.def: bud, flower; rush, reed; to bloom

ety.hint: A flower 艹 unfolding 包; 包 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap) as the sound and hint: the wrapped flower, a bud.

苞.name: bract

茁.def: to sprout, to flourish; vigorous, healthy

ety.hint: Sprouting 出 grass 艹; 出 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 出 (go out) as the sound, which also fits: grass coming out of the ground, sprouting, sturdy.

茁.name: sprouting

origin.says: 艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 矛 (spear) as the sound: thatch grass, rushes.
Simplified from 楓: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 風 (wind) as the sound, now 风: the maple tree.
A late character: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound, imitating a low murmuring or rumbling sound.

Originally written 呪: 口 (mouth) plus 兄 (elder, one who speaks to the spirits), words of a spell. In the modern form the mouth moved beside the other 口 (mouth) and the person below became 几 (small table).

咏.def: to sing, to hum, to chant

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 永 (long) as the sound: to draw out the voice, to chant. Simplified from 詠, where the meaning part was 言 (speech); it was swapped for 口.

咏.name: sing out

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 出 (go out) as the sound: a sharp cry of anger or reproach.
Simplified from 嶺: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 領 (collar) as the sound. The simplified form keeps only 令 (command) as the sound part. A mountain ridge.
辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 失 (lose) as the sound: one going after another, alternating, hence repeatedly.

ety.hint: Dried 干 grain stalks 禾; 干 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 稈: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 旱 (gǎn-like sound) as the sound: the stalk of grain, straw. The simplified form replaces 旱 with 干, the same sound.
Simplified from 骯: 骨 (bone) for the meaning plus 亢 (high) as the sound; the bone side was swapped for 月 (flesh). Used in the word for dirty.
犭 (dog, beast) for the meaning plus 宁 (calm), from 寧, as the sound: fierce, savage-looking like a beast. Simplified from 獰.
Early forms are 衣 (clothes) with a mark added, perhaps a finished garment or a soldier's tunic: so 'soldier' and 'to finish'. The marked 衣 has since changed shape into 亠, two 人 (person) and 十 (ten).
A picture of a threshing tool or flail; another view says the origin is unclear. Borrowed for the 7th heavenly stem and for 'age'. The modern shape only looks like 广 (shelter).
火 (fire) for the meaning plus 亢 (high) as the sound: a brick bed heated by a fire beneath it.

沽.def: to buy and sell; of inferior quality

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound. First a river name; borrowed for 'to buy and sell', first said of wine.

沽.name: buy wine

ety.hint: Still 宁 water 氵; 宁 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 濘: 氵 (water) plus 寧 (calm) as the sound, still water, mud. 寧 was simplified to 宁.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 正 (upright) as the sound: a startled heart, frozen in a daze.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 台 (platform) as the sound: a pleased heart, gladness.
宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 夗 (curled up) as the sound; perhaps first a house, later 'winding, bent' and 'as if'.
弓 (bow) for the meaning plus 瓜 (melon) as the sound: a wooden bow, and so the curve of a bow, an arc.
辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 召 (to summon) as the sound: a long way to walk, distant.

ety.hint: Three 三 with accents to prevent forgery

origin.says: A form of 參 (a picture of stars over a person) borrowed for its sound to write three, with 三 (three) put at the bottom; used on cheques. The top stars became 厶 over 大.
马 (horse) for the meaning plus 句 (hooked) as the sound: a young horse. Simplified from 駒 by the cursive horse 马.

驼.def: camel; humpback; to carry on one's back

origin.says: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 它 (snake, it) as the sound: the camel, a beast of burden. Simplified from 駝 with 馬 (horse) in its short form.

驼.name: camel

ety.hint: A banker's 贝 two 二 with accents to prevent forgery

origin.says: 贝 (money) for the meaning plus 弍 (an old form of two) as the sound: two, the fraud-proof form written on bills. 贝 sits inside 弍.

玷.def: character flaw; a flaw in a gem

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 占 (divine) as the sound: a flaw in a piece of jade, hence a blemish on one's character.

玷.name: flaw

拭.def: to wipe away stains with a cloth

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 式 (pattern) as the sound: to wipe clean with a cloth.

拭.name: dab clean

拱.def: to salute, to bow; arched; arch

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 共 (two hands together) as the sound and meaning: to join the hands in salute; hence an arch.

拱.name: arch

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 𢦏 (a cutting weapon, here only a sound part) as the sound: a word said at the end of an exclamation, like 'alas!'. The mouth sits inside 𢦏.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 全 (whole) as the sound: to tie up, to fasten.

垛.def: heap, pile; to heap, to pile

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 朵 (blossom) as the sound: a heap or pile, a battlement.

垛.name: pile

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 在 (to be at) as the sound: the stubble left in a field after harvest, and so a crop in its turn or an occasion.
艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 因 (cause, once 'mat') as the sound: a mat or cushion woven of grass.

荧.def: to shine, to shimmer; shining, dazzling

origin.says: From 熒: a picture of two crossed torches with 火 (fire) below: a glimmering light. The torch top was simplified to look like 艹 (grass) over 冖 (cover).

荧.name: glimmer

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 劦 (three strengths together) as the sound: a plant name, now the lychee.

ety.hint: A tree 木 bearing sweet fruit 甘; 甘 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 甘 (sweet) as the sound, which also fits: the tree with sweet fruit, the tangerine.

ety.hint: To pull water 水 out of stone 石

origin.says: A modern character: 石 (stone) over 水 (water), water drawn up out of rock. It was made to write the English loanword 'pump'.
鸟 (bird) for the meaning plus 区 (district) as the sound: a gull. Simplified from 鷗 by the shorthand 区 and the cursive bird 鸟.

ety.hint: Chives 非 growing in the ground 一

origin.says: A picture of leeks growing from the ground (the bottom stroke). Unrelated to 非 (not).

盹.def: to doze, to nap, to nod off

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 屯 as the sound: eyes closing for a moment, to doze, to nap.

盹.name: doze

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 列 (row) as the sound: stretching the mouth, to grin or grimace.
日 (sun) for the meaning plus 召 (to summon) as the sound: bright as sunlight, clear and manifest.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 米 (rice) as the sound: the sound a cat makes, meow; also used for the metre.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 约 as the sound: an exclamation, 'oh!'. Simplified from 喲 (約 → 约).

ety.hint: Costing little 戋 money 贝; 戋 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 贝 (money) for the meaning plus 戋 (small) as the sound and a hint: of little value, cheap, low. Simplified from 賤, both parts in short forms.

贻.def: to hand down, to give to, to bequeath

origin.says: Simplified from 貽 (only 貝 became 贝): 贝 (cowrie shell, money) for the meaning plus 台 (platform) as the sound: a gift passed on, to bequeath.

贻.name: bequest

origin.says: Simplified from 鈉: 金 (metal, now 钅) for the meaning plus 内 as the sound, which also echoes natrium: the metal sodium.

钧.def: unit of weight equal to thirty catties; your (formal)

origin.says: Simplified from 鈞: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 匀 (even) as the sound: a unit of weight of thirty catties, also a respectful 'your'.

钧.name: thirty catties

origin.says: Simplified from 氈: 亶 (sincere) as the sound plus 毛 (fur, hair) for the meaning, felt pressed from hair. The simplified form swaps 亶 for 占 (divine) as the sound.
Bronze forms show a creature built on 虫 (insect, snake); one reading sees an animal, another a hand holding a snake. Used for Yu the Great, the legendary tamer of the floods.

ety.hint: A person 亻 who might be a target 矦

origin.says: Originally 矦, a picture of an arrow 矢 (arrow) flying at a hanging target; the 亻 (person) was added later. The target-shooter of high rank became a lord, a marquis.
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 丕 (great) as the sound: the first lump of flesh of a new life, an embryo.
Simplified from 猙: 犭 (dog, beast) for the meaning plus 爭 (strive, shortened to 争) as the sound: fierce-looking.

饵.def: bait; cake; dumplings; to bait, to entice

origin.says: 饣 (food) for the meaning plus 耳 (ear) as the sound: cakes, and food used as bait. Simplified from 餌 by writing 食 as 饣.

饵.name: bait

origin.says: Simplified from 巒: 䜌 (tangled) as the sound plus 山 (mountain) for the meaning: a mountain range. 䜌 was cut down to a shape like 亦 (also), from cursive writing.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 仓 (granary) as the sound: a sore or boil. Simplified from 瘡, with 倉 (granary) shortened to 仓.
From 閨: 門 (gate, door) for the meaning plus 圭 (pointed jade tablet) as the sound, an arched inner door, then the women's quarters. The simplified form writes 門 in its cursive shape 门.

闽.def: Fujian province; a river; a tribe

origin.says: 虫 (snake) for the meaning plus 门 (gate) as the sound: the name of a southern people, perhaps snake worshippers, now Fujian province. Simplified from 閩, with 門 written 门.

闽.name: fujian

阀.def: clique, valve; a powerful and influential group

origin.says: Simplified from 閥: 門 (gate) for the meaning plus 伐 (chop down) as the sound: the pillar at a noble family's gate listing its merits, hence a powerful clique; 'valve' is borrowed from English.

阀.name: valve

ety.hint: A grain 米 seed 子; 子 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 米 (grain) for the meaning plus 子 (child, seed) as the sound and hint: seeds and pips.

ety.hint: A woman 女 looking up at a star 米

origin.says: Simplified from 婁, whose origin is unclear: one reading sees hands with a sound part over 女 (woman), another a mother and daughter. The top was reduced to 米 (rice) in shape only.
From 茲, built on two 幺 (silk skeins) under a top that later read as grass; its use for this, here, now is a sound loan. The modern form writes the top as 䒑, a variant made standard in mainland China.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 圭 (jade tablet) as the sound: a puddle, a low hollow. It also replaced 窪 (the same word with 穴 hole on top).

ety.hint: Seven 七 with accents to prevent forgery

origin.says: A variant of 漆 (lacquer): 氵 (liquid) plus 木 (tree), with 七 (seven) as the sound in place of the old top; borrowed as the cheque form of seven.

恃.def: to trust, to rely on; to presume

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 寺 as the sound: to lean on someone in one's heart, to rely on.

恃.name: count on

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 舌 (tongue), short for 甜 (sweet), as the sound: calm, content.

ety.hint: A minister 臣 in a statehouse 宀

origin.says: 宀 (house) over 臣 (servant): a servant of the house, then a court official.
Simplified from 襖: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 奥 (deep) as the sound. The simplified form swaps the sound part for the simpler 夭 (young), which sounds alike: a padded coat or jacket.
